records.source_population_selection: Unrelated western-European adults selected for GWAS, preferring the oldest family members. Exclusions: diabetes by self-report or FPG >=7.0 mmol/L; anemia at the reported sex-specific thresholds; missing HbA1c, erythrocytes or FPG. Source context: CTX_JANSEN_SELECTED.
records.measurement_assumptions: BMI kg/m^2; age years; native FPG plasma mmol/L; HbA1c NGSP-percent affine representation of native IFCC; female=1,male=0 assumed encoding; Constrains source BMI-H raw correlation only after explicit uniform-marginal and independent-nuisance assumptions; that derived rank dependence is transported, not the raw regression slope.
records.source_uncertainty_treatment: Point-scenario only. No reported SE; Jansen printed interval confidence level unconfirmed. Marginal SDs describe individuals, not regression uncertainty. No CI-to-SD conversion, precision weight, or tolerance.
records.cross_source_overlap: Jansen's two regressions and all its margins share one source family; each Bao/MIND relationship shares its own marginal population. Named cohort families are distinct but participant overlap is unverified. Records are not pooled as independent precision information.
records.identifies: One source projection or correlation point under its reported estimand; it does not identify the complete joint distribution, target coefficient, conditional age effect, or individual measurements.
records.reason: Constrains source BMI-H raw correlation only after explicit uniform-marginal and independent-nuisance assumptions; that derived rank dependence is transported, not the raw regression slope.
